run_mean_pool_features: run mean pooling on wav2vec feature representations by compressing uniform splits of the data
run_mean_pool_with_subsample: run mean pooling on features with a custom subsample rate to control output size
run_mean_pool_remove_extra: run mean pooling on features and remove extra states that cannot be evenly pooled
run_mean_pool_pad_extra: run mean pooling on features and pad extra states with the last value instead of removing them
review_mean_pool_main: review the main function that loads features, copies metadata files, and performs mean pooling on each sample
